Synopsis:
    A stronger-than-expected August U.S. jobs report keeps the Fed under pressure ahead of a Friday CPI release and an imminent rate decision. Simultaneously, the ECB is expected to hike Thursday, diesel prices are at record highs, and a far-right party is close to taking power in a German state for the first time since WWII. China's crude oil imports remained weak in August, adding a commodity demand angle.
